Connections across the Bible

Every chapter of the Bible, left to right from Genesis to Revelation. Each arc joins two chapters that readers have linked most often — where the New Testament quotes the Old, where a theme returns, where one story echoes another. Colors show the section of the Bible an arc starts in.

Tap or hover an arc to see the chapters it joins, then open either end. Choose a book to isolate it.

Showing the 2,600 strongest chapter-to-chapter links. Data: OpenBible.info cross-references (CC BY).
